MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

2. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

3. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

4. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 5
   C. 16
   D. 8

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 15
   C. 22
   D. 44

6. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 48
   D. 14

7. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/2
   D. They are equal

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 12
   C. 14
   D. 10

9. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.7
   C. 15.6
   D. 21

10. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 49

11. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

12. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.25
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.205

13. Solve for x: x + 5 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 9
   C. 13
   D. 8

14. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 25
   C. 19
   D. 19.6

15. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 156

16. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 121

17. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.6
   C. 23.7
   D. 29

18. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 1

19. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 33
   D. 12

20. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 90

21. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/4

22. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 60
   C. 30
   D. 38

23. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 5

24. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 73
   C. 17
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
